lines.text: You are cooking dinner, and your hands are covered in flour.
Your phone buzzes. Your agent has stopped, and it just asked you a question.
It only wants to know whether to keep the old API. A simple question, but you cannot type.
Washing your hands and typing a reply takes a minute. Meanwhile the agent just sits there, waiting.
So tap the mic instead, and say your answer out loud, the way you would tell a teammate.
On a computer, a local Whisper model listens and transcribes right inside your browser.
On a phone, it simply uses the dictation your phone already has, so there is nothing to set up.
On desktop, your audio never leaves your machine. Nothing is uploaded to anyone, anywhere.
Your words appear as text, so you can check them, and fix a word, before anything is sent.
Happy with it? Send. The agent reads your answer and carries on with its work.
It works just as well when you are holding a baby, or carrying boxes up the stairs.
You can answer your agents without stopping whatever else you are doing.
What are you usually doing when an agent pings you? Tell us in the comments, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
